_comment: Copy to refresh_config.local.json (gitignored). Windows auth uses your logged-in session — no OAuth, no secret. Just paste your Sales Lines OData URL. Purchase Lines is optional.

entities.sales_lines: PASTE YOUR SALES LINES ODATA URL HERE
entities.sales_orders: PASTE YOUR SALES ORDERS ODATA URL HERE (needed for salesperson)
entities.purchase_lines: PASTE PURCHASE LINES URL to split On-PO vs Needs-PO (or leave text to skip)
entities.assembly_orders: PASTE ASSEMBLY ORDERS URL for 'On Assembly' status (or leave text to skip)
entities.production_orders: PASTE RELEASED PRODUCTION ORDERS URL for 'In Production' status (or leave text to skip)

_salesperson_field: Which Sales Orders field holds the DOMAIN\user salesperson. Default 'Assigned_User_ID'. If the probe shows the reviewer under a different field (e.g. 'Created_By'), set salesperson_field to that.
